propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling to 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) at compile time, but Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-settable with range 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when an administrator raises or removes the DC comment limit, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies

sanitize_comment reuses the description fitter fit_outbound through a shared constant, creating coupling that exposes comments to future description-fitting changes designed for different semantics (ADF-size on Cloud vs character count on DC)
the DC comment ceiling is now configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, resolving the data-loss window for operators aware of their instance's setting
application-properties endpoint is admin-only and unreadable by rebar's non-admin PAT, making auto-discovery of the live limit unfeasible; configuration is the supported mechanism
